title: Fix zarg journey feedback

params.title: Operator types a custom answer
params.when: the operator chooses to type free text instead of selecting an option

then.text: Validate typed answer against option schema
Store custom_answer field beside recommended_option
Resolve next question from custom_answer

params.title: Operator selects offered option
params.when: the operator chooses one of the question options

params.title: Show the picked topic's options
params.when: the picked topic's node is queried for its options

then.text: its question with options appears
an empty-topic fallback is defined
a recommended option is marked

state.text: the operator's next choice is explicit

params.title: Operator picks a topic
params.when: the operator picks a topic

params.text: the topic becomes the focus and a recommended option question appears
the message shapes the wording; the agenda filters the options

params.when: the Driver Agent applies the agenda rule to the options

state.text: the rationale shows the agenda rule and the message evidence
the Operator picks the marked option or asks to clarify

params.title: Driver Agent handles an unusable message
params.when: the message conflicts with the agenda

then.text: the Operator is asked to clarify the message
the prior topic is kept open

params.text: the section stays within its pixel share, long Markdown collapsed

state.text: a collapse/expand toggle, copy, or open-full afford long reports, tables, code
the Operator continues, collapses, expands, or acts

params.title: Operator handles a report exceeding its share
params.when: the Markdown exceeds its pixel share

then.text: the report truncates, scrolls, shrinks font, or the share expands

params.when: the operator confirms one option after discussion

state.text: the saved answer carries the option and its reason
the operator can amend or reopen the saved choice
the Driver Agent reads the agenda again and one question with options is shown

params.title: Driver Agent re-asks when no option settles
params.when: no option settles after discussion

then.text: another question with options is shown
the operator is asked to confirm before saving

params.title: Operator resolves a conflict-resolution pick
params.when: the operator resolves the conflict by choosing a version

params.text: the merge question shows both versions and their origins
the chosen version is applied with discarded edits reconciled

params.title: Operator saves resolved conflict
params.when: the operator saves the resolved conflict

then.text: the answer and rationale are saved to the graph
the merge decision notes chosen source and discarded side
the saved outcome offers accept, edit, or revisit

params.title: Operator handles no fitting version
params.when: the operator defers a no-fit merge

then.text: the merge is deferred or conflict flagged
both versions remain open for combine

params.title: Operator rechecks stale save
params.when: the operator rechecks a refused stale save

then.text: the merge question is reopened
the pick is reconfirmed

params.title: Operator reviews chosen version
params.when: the operator reviews the chosen version writes

then.text: the operator confirms the chosen version
the resolved conflict proceeds to save

params.title: Operator previews merge diff
params.when: the operator previews the incoming diff

then.text: the diff preview shows incoming writes and origins

params.text: one question with options and a Chat affordance is shown

params.title: Operator chats and signals Continue or Return
params.when: operator sends a chat turn and taps Continue or Return

params.text: chat mode keeps current topic and original options reachable
operator message writes to graph and recomputed next question renders

params.title: Operator continues or aborts chat
params.when: operator signals Continue or Return after chat

then.text: chat mode closes into next-question shaping
operator message writes to graph and next question renders
recomputed recommendation previews with next options
original options are re-presented when chat yields nothing

params.title: Renderer recognises a Mermaid fenced block
params.when: the reply holds a fenced code block

arrives.text: the renderer reads the fence's language tag

then.text: a mermaid tag makes the block a diagram candidate
other tags stay ordinary formatted code

params.text: the Markdown shows a formatted Mermaid block

state.text: the diagram mimics structure only, arrows and labels as characters

params.title: Overflow or absent support fallback
params.when: the diagram does not fit or Mermaid support is absent

arrives.text: the candidate exceeds the window or the renderer lacks Mermaid support

then.text: the diagram is shown clipped or scrollable with a clear affordance
or the Mermaid source appears with a 'not drawn' cue
the text around it stays formatted
never blanking silently

params.title: Streaming reply renders candidate progressively
params.when: the candidate arrives during streaming

arrives.text: a diagram candidate appears in the streaming reply

then.text: the diagram renders progressively as box-drawing characters

params.text: the edits merge by same node and same field

params.title: Driver Agent merges compatible edits after version drift resolves
params.when: the staleness resolves by version match

params.title: Merge provands into a named record
params.when: the Driver Agent saves the merged answer

then.text: the merge_id records the two source edits
the merged versions are recorded for audit
the next choice asks accept-merge or continue

params.when: the Driver Agent reads the agenda for the saved answer

params.title: Driver Agent asks the next question
params.when: a question has no saved answer

arrives.text: the agenda holds one unanswered item

then.text: one question with options is shown
the answer is saved to the graph

params.text: one unanswered agenda item with options is shown
the chosen option id and its question reference are stored in the graph entry
a confirm signal is emitted and the next question or resolution is shown

params.title: Operator's choice lands
params.when: the operator picks an option

then.text: a confirmation is shown naming the stored option id
the current question's entry carries the option reference
choices to proceed revise or undo are shown
when questions remain the agenda step is routed to
when none remain the resolution node is reached

params.title: An invalid or absent pick recovers
params.when: the operator picks nothing or an invalid option

then.text: the question is re-presented with its options
a save failure surfaces a retry and error line
a skip defer or go-back branch is offered

state.text: the save loop routes to the next question id when questions remain

params.title: Operator picks one answer in a repeated series
params.when: the operator picks an option from the shown question

params.title: Reveal the stale node
params.when: the shown question reaches a revision

arrives.text: a node revision marker appears on the shown question

then.text: the operator sees the node as contended before answering
the shown question carries a revision token into the answer

params.title: Refusal names cause and recovery
params.when: the save is refused as stale

arrives.text: the refusal message from the graph

then.text: the refusal names the changed node and its changer
the typed answer is re-asked against the current node
a refresh affordance appears for the operator

state.text: the save refusal leads to re-asking the current node

params.text: one question is shown against its current node

params.when: zarg replies with streaming Markdown

params.title: Streaming renderer recovers at boundaries
params.when: a table or code block boundary breaks mid-stream

arrives.text: the operator starts zarg in a repo

then.text: partial segment renders as plain fallback text
full reply re-rendered with boundaries intact

params.title: Operator chooses next action on reply
params.when: the formatted Markdown reply streams

arrives.text: the rendered formatted reply reaches the operator

then.text: the operator approves, revises, stops, or continues

state.text: the reply offers next-action choices to the operator
